ryans.name: Ryan Cohen
ryans.title: Chairman and CEO of GameStop; co-founder of Chewy
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Cohen** (born 1986, according to Wikipedia) is a Canadian businessman and investor. He co-founded the online pet retailer Chewy in 2011 and is chairman and chief executive of GameStop [1]. PetSmart bought Chewy in 2017 for $3.35 billion, which Fortune and Wikipedia describe as the largest e-commerce acquisition at the time [1][3].
known_for: $3.35 billion sale of Chewy to PetSmart
GameStop turnaround as chairman and CEO

ryans.name: Ryan Reynolds
ryans.title: Actor and businessman
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Rodney Reynolds** (born October 23, 1976) is a Canadian-American actor, producer, and entrepreneur. He is best known for starring as the Marvel antihero Deadpool, and for building consumer brands and a Welsh football club alongside film work [1][2][3].

ryans.name: Ryan Serhant
ryans.title: Founder and CEO of SERHANT.; star of Owning Manhattan
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Matthew Serhant** (born 1984) is an American real estate broker, entrepreneur and television personality [16][2]. He founded and leads **SERHANT.**, a New York–based residential brokerage that also runs media, education and technology divisions [12][16]. He first became widely known as a cast member of Bravo's *Million Dollar Listing New York*, which premiered in 2012 [1][11]. Since June 2024 he has been the central figure of the Netflix reality series *Owning Manhattan*, which follows his company [15][16].
